name: Mubboo Flights Search
description: Free, no-key MCP for airport lookup, trip validation and flight-search links through find_airports, prepare_flight_search and get_service_info. The travel comparison website compares 800+ airlines and 100+ booking sites; booking options can include Booking.com, Trip.com, Expedia, Agoda and Kiwi.com depending on route, dates and market. MCP does not return live fares or availability, make bookings or process payments.
author: Mubboo Flights
